object.attr: as implemented: the same default as the MCP server, so mellon-check run from an agent's session checks the project the agent works on. The failure analysis recommends withdrawing it (CF-C1); a question for the person. The first line of the output names the folder either way.
object.description: When mellon-check runs without --repo-root and the CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR environment variable is set, mellon-check shall check the folder that the variable names.
